browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless, 1440x900, one isolated browser context per person
fixtures: roles-and-access-replay/fixtures.json (roles-and-access-replay/setup.mjs); every record is named DOC-032 compat compat-a <name> 09280716

steps.action: Put the roles fixture records in their starting state and create this run's approval requests (API).
steps.expected: Jonas is on no fixture team; the Confidential records hold only their creator; three approval requests name Jonas.
steps.actual: Reset answers: 404,404,404,404,404,404,404,404,200,200,200. Approval requests naming Jonas on C-267, C-268 (Confidential primary Document) and C-269.

steps.action: Open Settings > Users and a Business User's role control.
steps.expected: Account types are Administrator, Legal Team Member and Business User; Contributor is no longer an account type; an Administrator can change an account to Legal Team Member.
steps.actual: The Role column showed Administrator, Legal team member, Business user and no Contributor. Ravi Menon's role control offered "Administrator Legal team member Business user". Escape closed it with no change.

steps.action: As a Legal Team Member, open Settings > Users.
steps.expected: Organization settings remain Administrator-only.
steps.actual: Nadia at /settings/users landed on /settings/profile with no Invite user; an organization settings write answered 403.

steps.action: Open a non-Confidential Contract and Matter without a team row.
steps.expected: A Legal Team Member has full legal work on open records.
steps.actual: Nadia (no team row) opened C-75 "DOC-032 compat compat-a open contract 09280716" and M-26 "DOC-032 compat compat-a open matter 09280716".

steps.action: Open a Confidential Contract and Matter with no team row, no Legal Owner and no Matter Manager; reload.
steps.expected: Administrator status does not bypass the Confidential rule; a copied link or reload cannot restore access.
steps.actual: Daniel saw "Contract not found" / "This Contract does not exist, or you cannot open it." for C-77 on the copied link and after reload; M-27 showed "Matter not found".

steps.action: Open the open parent Matter and the open child Contract whose parent is Confidential.
steps.expected: An unreachable related record shows as Restricted contract or Restricted Matter with no link; a parent's team and Confidential flag do not pass to child Contracts.
steps.actual: On M-26 Daniel saw "Restricted Matter" for the Confidential child M-27 and "Restricted contract" for the linked C-77, with no links to their titles. Daniel opened the open child C-81; its parent (Confidential C-80) showed as "Restricted contract" with no link. Jonas, on the parent's team, opened C-80 in the Portal but the child showed "Contract not found".

steps.action: As Creator and Legal Owner, open Contract team, select Add team member, choose Daniel in Person, select Add.
steps.expected: Each person appears once with no role picker; the Administrator can then open the Confidential record.
steps.actual: The Add team member dialog had one control, Person, and no role picker; Nadia (already on the team) was not offered. Roster: NH Legal Owner Creator Nadia Haddad | DO Daniel Okafor. Daniel then opened C-77 "DOC-032 compat compat-a confidential contract 09280716".

steps.action: As an Administrator who can reach the Confidential record, check the audience controls.
steps.expected: An Administrator who can reach the record may change its Confidential audience.
steps.actual: Daniel (team row, Administrator) had Add team member, the Confidential switch and the Legal Owner control enabled on C-77.

steps.action: Add Priya (Legal Team Member, not Creator or Legal Owner) to the team; as Priya, check the audience controls and try to name a new Legal Owner.
steps.expected: Being able to read the record does not give the right to change its audience; naming a new Legal Owner is an audience change.
steps.actual: Priya opened C-77. Add team member disabled; Confidential switch disabled; 3 remove controls, none enabled; Legal Owner control enabled true: choosing Priya Raman showed "Only an Administrator, the contract's creator, or its Owner can change the team on a confidential contract."; after reload the Legal Owner control read "NH Nadia Haddad". Naming herself Legal Owner through the record write answered 403 ("Only an Administrator, the contract's creator, or its Owner can change the team on a confidential contract.").

steps.action: Remove Priya and Daniel with each person's remove control.
steps.expected: Removal ends Confidential access on the next read.
steps.actual: After Nadia removed both rows, Daniel's and Priya's reloads of C-77 showed "does not exist, or you cannot open it".

steps.action: Name Daniel Legal Owner on the Confidential Contract in Overview; then Daniel names Nadia again.
steps.expected: A Legal Owner reaches a Confidential Contract without a team row; changing the owner back ends it.
steps.actual: After Nadia set Legal Owner to Daniel, Daniel opened C-77 (roster: DO Legal Owner Daniel Okafor | NH Creator Nadia Haddad). Daniel set Legal Owner back to Nadia; his reload was then refused and Nadia kept access.

steps.action: On the Confidential Matter, add and remove Daniel's team row, then name him Matter Manager and change it back.
steps.expected: A team row or Matter Manager admits the person; removal ends access.
steps.actual: Daniel opened M-27 through a team row, was refused after removal, opened it again as Matter Manager, and was refused after he named Nadia Matter Manager again.

steps.action: Add and remove Nadia on the open Contract team; read its Confidential Document each time.
steps.expected: Removing a Legal Team Member from an open record does not end ordinary access; a Document's Confidential flag narrows its audience.
steps.actual: The Confidential Document doc032-compat-a-confidential-note.txt was hidden from Nadia before, shown while she was on the team, and hidden after removal; she still opened C-75. Daniel (creator, Legal Owner) saw it throughout.

steps.action: As Administrator and as a Legal Team Member without a Grant, open a Confidential Entity.
steps.expected: Every person needs a Grant for a Confidential Entity; Administrators need one too.
steps.actual: Daniel saw "Entity not found" and Priya saw "Entity not found" for the Confidential Entity; neither has a Grant.

steps.action: As the creator, use Manage access to give Daniel a Grant, then remove it.
steps.expected: The creator has a Grant; a grantee gives and removes Grants with Manage access; a Grant applies to that Entity only.
steps.actual: Manage access opened Confidential access with Nadia's creator Grant listed. Person offered 29 staff people and no Business Users. After Grant access, Daniel opened the Entity and saw Manage access, but the second Confidential Entity still showed "Entity not found". After Remove Daniel Okafor, Daniel's reload was refused.

steps.action: Try to remove the only Grant.
steps.expected: A Confidential Entity must keep at least one active person with a Grant.
steps.actual: Removing the only Grant was refused (Grant another person access before removing the last person from a confidential entity.); Nadia still opened the Entity.

steps.action: Open a non-Confidential Entity as Administrator and as a Legal Team Member.
steps.expected: An Administrator can manage access on an Entity that is not Confidential.
steps.actual: On "Helix Software Group, Inc." Daniel saw Manage access and Nadia (no Grant) did not. No Grant was changed.

steps.action: As a Business User, open full-app records, Entities and Settings addresses.
steps.expected: Business Users work through the Portal and cannot open the Entities module.
steps.actual: /contracts/75 -> /portal; /entities -> /portal; /entities/01a0e6df-8c06-7f26-ad59-46c17e7de924 -> /portal; /settings/users -> /portal. Portal navigation: "Requests Approvals Contracts Matters Auto-Docs". An Entity read answered 403.

steps.action: Open Portal addresses of records whose teams do not include the Business User.
steps.expected: Business Users reach only non-archived records whose teams include them.
steps.actual: /portal/contracts/75: Contract not found; /portal/contracts/77: Contract not found; /portal/matters/26: Matter not found; /portal/matters/27: Matter not found

steps.action: Open the Business User's converted Request address.
steps.expected: At conversion the Requester becomes Business Owner and a team member; the old Request address leads to that record.
steps.actual: /portal/requests/67 led to /portal/contracts/265. Contract team: NH Legal Owner Creator Nadia Haddad | JW Business Owner Jonas Weber.

steps.action: Open Contract team on the open Contract, Add team member, choose Jonas, Add.
steps.expected: Adding a Business User gives them access to the record in the Portal.
steps.actual: After Nadia added Jonas, he opened /portal/contracts/75 "DOC-032 compat compat-a open contract 09280716".

steps.action: As the later-added Business User, open Comments and reply.
steps.expected: Business Users read and post Full Thread comments with the Contract Team label, see earlier Contract Team comments, and do not see Legal Only or older Internal team comments.
steps.actual: Jonas, added after the three fixture comments, saw the earlier Full Thread comment ("NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team 31 minutes ago ") and neither the Legal Only nor the Working Team comment; no audience picker. His reply row read "JW Jonas Weber Contract Team this minute ".

steps.action: As Legal, open Comments on the Contract and on a Matter.
steps.expected: Legal chooses Contract Team or Matter Team above New comment; Full Thread rows show Contract Team; Legal Only and older Internal team rows show those labels.
steps.actual: Audience above New comment offered "Audience Legal Only Contract Team" on the Contract and "Audience Legal Only Matter Team" on the Matter. Row labels: Full Thread "NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team 31 minutes ago "; Legal Only "NH Nadia Haddad Legal Only 31 minutes ago "; older Working Team "NH Nadia Haddad Internal team 31 minutes ago ".

steps.action: Legal changes the open Contract one item at a time; the Business User reads Portal History after each.
steps.expected: History shows Contract Team comments, Stage moves, owners, Value, dates, Visible on Portal Fields, and Tasks added or completed; it excludes Legal Only and Internal team comments, Priority, Risk and Fields not Visible on Portal.
steps.actual: Priority change: not shown (0 new); Risk change: not shown (0 new); Legal Only comment: not shown (0 new); Working Team (Internal team) comment: not shown (0 new); Field kept off the Portal changed: not shown (0 new); Field with Visible on Portal changed: shown (1 new contract.updated); Task added with a due date: shown (1 new task.added); Second task added: shown (1 new task.added); Task edited: not shown (0 new); Tasks reordered: not shown (0 new); Task completed: shown (1 new task.completed); Task removed: not shown (0 new); Value changed: shown (1 new contract.updated); Expiry date changed: shown (1 new contract.updated); Stage move to Internal review (review): shown (1 new contract.stage_changed); Full Thread (team) comment: shown (1 new comment.posted); Legal Owner change: shown (1 new). Portal History panel: "History Nadia Haddad commented this minute Nadia Haddad changed the stage Draft → Review this minute Nadia Haddad changed Expiry date Not set → Mar 14, 2029 this minute Nadia Haddad changed Value Not set → £1,000.00 /year this minute Nadia Haddad completed the task DOC-032 compat compat-a probe task A edited 591362 this minute Nadia Haddad added the task DOC-032 compat compat-a probe task B 591362 this minute Nadia Haddad added the task DOC-032 compat compat-a probe task A 591362, due Dec 15 this minute Nadia Haddad changed DOC-032 compat compat-a Visible field 09280716 Not set → DOC-032 compat compat-a shown change 591362 this minute Nadia Haddad changed Contract type NDA → DOC-032 compat c". Screenshot kept in the system temp folder, not in the worktree.

steps.action: Look for Field, Task, Key date, approval request and signing controls on the Portal record.
steps.expected: The Portal record has no controls for Fields, Tasks, Key dates, approval requests or signing.
steps.actual: No Field inputs (0), no Task, Key date, approval or signing controls; main buttons were: Upload documents, Drop files here or click to upload, Search, doc032-compat-a-baseline.txt, Add version, doc032-compat-a-confidential-note.txt.

steps.action: In the Portal, open Contract team, Add team member, choose an existing person, Add.
steps.expected: Business Users may add existing people from the Portal on non-Confidential records; there is no remove control.
steps.actual: Jonas added Amara Nwosu (existing members were not offered); no remove control in the Portal. Nadia saw Amara on the same team in the full app and removed her.

steps.action: On Overview, assign Amara as Business Owner; try to remove her; change the Business Owner; remove her; then clear the Business Owner.
steps.expected: Assigning a Business Owner adds that person to the team; change or clear the Business Owner before removing them; reassignment leaves the former owner on the team; removal ends Business User access on the next read, including old links, replies and Documents.
steps.actual: Setting Business Owner to Amara added her row: DO Legal Owner Creator Daniel Okafor | AN Business Owner Amara Nwosu | JW Jonas Weber. Her row had no remove control, and a direct removal answered 409 "Change the Business Owner before removing this person from the team.". Amara opened C-75 in the Portal (her roster: DO Legal Owner Creator Daniel Okafor | AN Business Owner Amara Nwosu | JW Jonas Weber). After Business Owner changed to Jonas, Amara stayed on the team (DO Legal Owner Creator Daniel Okafor | JW Business Owner Jonas Weber | AN Amara Nwosu). Nadia then removed her; Amara's reload of the old link showed Contract not found, a Documents read answered 404 and a reply answered 404. Business Owner cleared to Unassigned; Jonas kept his team row (DO Legal Owner Creator Daniel Okafor | JW Jonas Weber).

steps.action: Legal adds Jonas to the open Matter and posts with Matter Team and Legal Only; Legal moves its Status.
steps.expected: A Full Thread comment shows Matter Team; Legal Only stays hidden; the Status move appears in Portal History; linked and child Confidential records stay closed.
steps.actual: Nadia's rows: "NH Nadia Haddad Matter Team this minute " and "NH Nadia Haddad Legal Only this minute ". Jonas saw the Matter Team comment ("NH Nadia Haddad Matter Team this minute ") and not the Legal Only one. Matter History probe: Priority change: not shown (0 new); Risk change: not shown (0 new); Legal Only comment: not shown (0 new); Working Team (Internal team) comment: not shown (0 new); Task added with a due date: shown (1 new task.added); Second task added: shown (1 new task.added); Task edited: not shown (0 new); Tasks reordered: not shown (0 new); Task completed: shown (1 new task.completed); Task removed: not shown (0 new); Status move to In progress: shown (1 new matter.status_changed); Full Thread (team) comment: shown (1 new comment.posted). Linked C-77 showed "Contract not found" and child M-27 showed "Matter not found"; the Matter page named neither.

steps.action: Legal adds Jonas to the Confidential Contract; Jonas opens Contract team; Legal removes him.
steps.expected: A Business User needs a team row on a Confidential record; Portal team changes on Confidential records stay with Legal.
steps.actual: With a team row Jonas opened C-77; Add team member was disabled with "Ask Legal to add members to a Confidential record." After removal his reload showed Contract not found.

steps.action: Open Approvals in the Portal; open a request; open one whose primary Document is Confidential; Legal withdraws one request and archives one Contract.
steps.expected: The request shows the Contract title and current primary Document, no team row, comments, Fields or other Documents; a Confidential primary Document is not shown to an approver off the team; withdrawal or archiving ends access.
steps.actual: Your approvals (Pending) listed the three DOC-032 compat compat-a requests created for this run naming Jonas. The open request read "All approvals C-267 DOC-032 compat compat-a open approval 591362 Pending doc032-compat-a-open-paper-591362.txt Download Download the document to review it 46 byte Download Approval request NH Requested by Nadia Haddad Requested Sep 28, 2026, 11:46 AM GMT+4 You" with no applet bar, Fields, comments or team; /portal/contracts/267 showed "Contract not found". The request whose primary Document is Confidential read "All approvals C-268 DOC-032 compat compat-a confidentialPaper approval 591362 Pending Primary document No document attached No primary document is available. Contact the requester if you need a docume". Legal withdrew one request (200) and archived the other Contract (200); both left Your approvals, and the withdrawn request's address read "". Legal restored the Contract afterwards (200).

steps.action: Legal archives the converted Contract; the Business User opens Your Contracts, the record link and the old Request link.
steps.expected: An archived record leaves the Portal; the old Request link shows the original ask and an archived notice, without Documents or a conversation.
steps.actual: Legal archived C-265 (200). Your Contracts no longer listed it; its link showed "Contract not found". The old Request link read "Your requests DOC-032 compat compat-a Jonas request 09280716 In progress R-67 · Contract review · Submitted Sep 28 The record created from this Request was archived. Your original request is shown below. What you submitted Description DOC-032 compat compat-a f" with no Documents and no comment controls. Legal restored C-265 (200).
